title: Build an SEO & content engine
summary: A repeatable content loop: research keywords, draft with an agent, human-edit, publish to the site, submit the sitemap, and watch what ranks.

parts.title: Keyword and topic research
parts.guidance: Collect customer questions and search language, then compare current results and available search data with existing site coverage in the intended markets. Prioritize questions the company can answer with specific knowledge or examples. Give each proposed article a reader, question and evidence source.

execution.rationale: Research search questions and existing coverage to prepare source-linked article proposals.

parts.title: Draft content with an agent
parts.guidance: Give the drafting agent the reader's question, audience, company knowledge, examples and sources. Draft a direct answer, marking unsupported claims for subject-matter review. Keep private customer information out of tools without authority to use it. Deliver an editable article with source notes and specific questions for the editor.

execution.rationale: Draft an editable article from the supplied knowledge and evidence, flagging claims for specialist review.

parts.title: Editorial review
parts.guidance: Read the article for a useful answer to its reader's question and an accurate description of the current product. Verify factual claims, try instructions where practical and obtain specialist review for regulated topics. Remove invented real-world examples, unauthorized customer references and search-oriented filler. Return precise corrections or an edited version ready for the named publication owner.

execution.rationale: Edit and fact-check the article against source evidence, handing regulated questions and publication approval to their owners.

parts.title: Publish to the site
parts.guidance: Load the edited article into the site's publishing system with its sources, headings, links and intended URL. Preview small and large screens and check downloads and navigation. Publish the version cleared by the content owner, then read the live page to verify assets, links and intended indexing settings. Pass the live URL to the content measurement and maintenance workflow.

execution.rationale: The stated Vercel method publishes the edited site through its connected repository; inspect the live article, assets and indexing settings.

parts.title: Submit sitemap to search engines
parts.guidance: Check that the sitemap lists the intended canonical public pages and excludes drafts and private content. Validate its format and public URL, then submit or inspect it through the search engine's supported site tools using authorized access. Investigate reported errors. Google treats sitemap submission as a hint, so verify subsequent indexing observations separately from successful submission.

verify.how: Search Console shows the sitemap fetched with status Success and pages discovered.

execution.rationale: Search Console documents sitemap submission and error inspection for an authorized property; indexing remains separately observed.

parts.title: Monitor traffic and rankings
parts.guidance: Review the content program's pages, queries and conversions over a consistent reporting window. Compare search impressions, clicks and positions with site outcomes, publication dates and tracking changes. Investigate useful impressions that lead to weak engagement or broken conversion paths. Recommend specific updates, identifying other changes that could explain the observed ranking movement.

execution.rationale: Search Console's performance reports expose page/query impressions, clicks and positions for comparison with supplied site outcomes.

metadata.supportReason: Drafting, publishing, and sitemap submission are agent-runnable. Editorial review before publishing at scale is a human gate.
